JSONP helpers for GUI summary, slot, peer, shred, and metric responses.

# Purpose
This C file implements JSON and JSONP style output helpers for the GUI HTTP layer. It builds response envelopes and field values for many GUI data types, including summary status, startup and boot progress, slots, epochs, peers, gossip network data, shreds, transaction waterfalls, tile metrics, and rankings. Most functions write directly to `fd_http_server_t` through `fd_http_server_printf`, and they use helper routines such as [`jsonp_open_object`](<#jsonp_open_object>), [`jsonp_close_object`](<#jsonp_close_object>), [`jsonp_string`](<#jsonp_string>), [`jsonp_ulong`](<#jsonp_ulong>), and [`jsonp_null`](<#jsonp_null>) to format structured responses.

The file is part of the GUI output path, not an executable entry point. It defines public formatting APIs such as [`fd_gui_printf_version`](<#fd_gui_printf_version>), [`fd_gui_printf_peers_all`](<#fd_gui_printf_peers_all>), [`fd_gui_printf_slot_request`](<#fd_gui_printf_slot_request>), and [`fd_gui_peers_printf_gossip_stats`](<#fd_gui_peers_printf_gossip_stats>), which other code can call to serialize current runtime state into response payloads. It also includes data checks and conversions, such as UTF-8 validation, string sanitization, base58 encoding, and conditional output of `null` when a value is not available.
